description: Respuesta Sísmica. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Distrital de Gestión de Riesgos y Cambio Climático - IDIGER. Zona de suelo de áreas de homogéneo comportamiento ante las ondas sísmicas, es decir que tengan similar amplificación y respuesta espectral. Su cobertura es el Distrito Capital. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Distrital de Gestión de Riesgos y Cambio Climático - IDIGER. Its tags are Amenaza, Deslizamiento, Geología, Geomorfología, Respuesta Sísmica. It offers 9 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2023-12-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
